parts.text: I keep the shared picture of the airspace by working with the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones that group them, and the closures announced by the authorities. When the authorities announce planned closures with a start and end time, or sudden ones that apply at once, I enter them into the system. These closures can be amended during the day, such as when an area is widened or an end time moves, and they can even come into force while drones of several companies are already in the air. When I enter a closure, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers.
